description: Tribal Trouble Buffed: this fork's new content, layered on Resurrected, whose numbers it keeps. New buildings: the Chicken Coop / Henhouse and the Totem / Runestone (milestone M5, PLAN.md section 4.5). New gear from the Armory: the Shield (Bark-Shield Bearer / Round-Shield Carl) and the Torch (Firebrand / Torchbearer), which fight hand to hand; a torch sets buildings on fire (milestone M6, PLAN.md section 4.4, docs/design/gear.md). Their numbers are repeated here so Buffed's balance reads in one file. Field reference: docs/rulesets.md.
